column2: Every transport by which configuration reaches the Colorlight E120, with the
frame identifiers this repo has verified. All frames are raw Ethernet:
dst MAC 11:22:33:44:55:66, src MAC 22:22:33:44:55:66, the "EtherType" slot
(frame offset 12..13) abused as a 2-byte packet type. Payload starts at offset 14
for control frames; the FPP pixel/sync/brightness frames put their first DATA
byte at frame offset 13, i.e. inside the second EtherType byte.

column2: BOOT-TIME PATH (what the card reads for itself, no host involved)
flash block 0x07 (0x70000..0x7FFFF) holds the compiled parameter image; region
map in docs/compiled-image-format.md. Page 0xF0 (0x7F000) is the EEPROM-backed
screen-size record. The bitstream itself is in blocks 0x00-0x0A with a golden
copy at 0x20. The gateware has CCLK.MODE = USRMCLK and OSC.MODE = OSCG, so the
FPGA drives the config-flash SPI clock AT RUNTIME and can read flash while
running - which is what makes a boot-time parameter load possible at all.
